- Host adapters forward `--model` **verbatim** with no per-host normalisation, even though codex/copilot want a bare id (`gpt-5.5`) while opencode/aider want `provider/model`.
- `aider` is not supported at all; the `copilot-cli` provider named in `Config::defaults()` is **never registered** (latent `UnknownProvider` bug — the executor role only works via the host path, not the Model path).

Anthropic models run via Claude Code, OpenAI via Codex, and copilot/opencode/aider authenticate themselves. # Plan: host-CLI-only model routing (5 hosts, curated models, no BYOK)

## Context

derrick today conflates two things and lets inference escape the host CLIs:

- `derrick-models` ships a **direct-API** `anthropic` provider (reqwest + `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`) plus an `openai-cli` provider with an API-key mode — i.e. it can call model APIs directly with user keys (BYOM, D12 / §6.5).
- The default model IDs are **stale**: config has `claude-opus-4-7`, `gpt-5`, `gpt-5-codex`; reality (May 2026) is Opus 4.8 / Sonnet 4.6 / Haiku 4.5, Codex `gpt-5.5`/`gpt-5.4`/`gpt-5.2-codex`, Copilot `gpt-5.4`/`gpt-5.3-codex`/`claude-sonnet-4.6`.
- Host adapters forward `--model` **verbatim** with no per-host normalisation, even though codex/copilot want a bare id (`gpt-5.5`) while opencode/aider want `provider/model`.
- `aider` is not supported at all; the `copilot-cli` provider named in `Config::defaults()` is **never registered** (latent `UnknownProvider` bug — the executor role only works via the host path, not the Model path).

**Desired outcome:** every model role resolves to exactly one of **5 host CLIs** — `claude`, `codex`, `copilot`, `opencode`, `aider` — which each manage their own auth. derrick holds no API keys. Anthropic models run via Claude Code, OpenAI via Codex, and copilot/opencode/aider authenticate themselves. Model choices are validated against a curated, current list (warn-and-pass-through on unknowns).

**User decisions (confirmed):**
1. **Host-CLI only** — delete direct-API providers + API-key/credential machinery; supersede **D12**, rewrite **§6.5**.
2. **Hybrid validation** — curated current model IDs drive defaults + `derrick models check`; unknown models **warn** and still pass through.
3. **aider is a first-class host adapter**, all auth delegated to aider's own config.
4. (Implied by "support these 5") opencode and aider become **first-class pipeline hosts** — the `Host` enum gains `Opencode` and `Aider`, not just role-path reachability.

## Decision to record: D64 — host-CLI-only model routing

Summary: Derrick routes ALL model inference through exactly **5 host CLIs** — `claude` (Claude Code), `codex`, `copilot` (GitHub Copilot CLI), `opencode`, `aider`. It holds **no API keys** ("no BYOK"): each host CLI manages its own auth. Direct-API providers are removed.

Key clauses to capture:
1. **Supersedes D12** (provider auth via env vars / `~/.derrick/credentials.yaml` / API keys). The new posture: env-passthrough only (env vars are forwarded to the host child process, e.g. `GH_TOKEN`/proxy vars); no derrick-held credentials; no `MissingCredential` checks.
2. **Provider == host.** The `derrick-models` `Model`-trait providers collapse into a single **host-delegated provider** that builds a `HostRequest` and calls the `derrick-tools` host adapter, wrapping the one `HostResponse` into a one-shot completion stream. `derrick-models` gains a dependency on `derrick-tools` (no cycle — tools is a leaf). The direct-API `anthropic` provider and the API-key mode of `openai-cli` are deleted. The `shell` provider survives as a bespoke-envelope escape hatch (not a host).
3. **Mapping:** anthropic models via claude, openai via codex; copilot/opencode/aider are multi-model front-ends that authenticate themselves.
4. **Hybrid validation:** a curated, current per-host model catalogue (owned by `derrick-tools`, `catalogue.rs`) drives defaults and `derrick models check`; unknown models **WARN and still pass through** to the CLI (never hard-fail on model id). Current IDs (May 2026): claude = claude-opus-4-8 / claude-sonnet-4-6 / claude-haiku-4-5; codex = gpt-5.5 / gpt-5.4 / gpt-5.4-mini / gpt-5.2-codex; copilot = gpt-5.4 / gpt-5.3-codex / claude-sonnet-4.6 / claude-haiku-4.5 / gpt-5.4-mini; opencode/aider use `provider/model` strings.

Done. All seven steps landed and independently verified — **fmt clean, clippy clean, 689 tests pass (0 failures)**, ~1,630 lines deleted vs ~644 added (the direct-API providers are gone). Nothing is committed; it's all in the working tree for your review.

## What changed

**The model layer now routes every role through one of 5 host CLIs — no API keys.** ([D64](DESIGN.md), §6.5 rewritten; supersedes D12)

- **One curated catalogue** ([crates/derrick-tools/src/catalogue.rs](crates/derrick-tools/src/catalogue.rs)) is the single source of truth for default models, per-host valid IDs, and ID normalisation. Current IDs baked in: claude `opus-4-8`/`sonnet-4-6`/`haiku-4-5`, codex `gpt-5.5`/`5.4`/`5.4-mini`/`5.2-codex`, copilot `gpt-5.4`/`5.3-codex`/`claude-sonnet-4.6`/etc.
- **Provider → host mapping is now literal:** anthropic→claude, openai→codex; copilot/opencode/aider authenticate themselves. The four `derrick-models` direct-API providers collapsed into one [host_delegated.rs](crates/derrick-models/src/providers/host_delegated.rs) that calls the `derrick-tools` adapters; `reqwest` and the API-key/`MissingCredential` machinery are gone (`AuthStore` is now env-passthrough only). `shell` survives as the escape hatch.
- **aider is a first-class host** ([aider.rs](crates/derrick-tools/src/hosts/aider.rs)) alongside opencode; both are now selectable as pipeline `host:` steps (the config `Host` enum gained `Opencode`+`Aider`).
- **Per-host `--model` normalisation** added to all five adapters (claude/codex/copilot strip the `provider/` prefix; opencode/aider pass `provider/model` verbatim; never translates dot↔dash).
- **`derrick models check`** ([commands/models.rs](crates/derrick-cli/src/commands/models.rs)) implements D15 with the hybrid rule: host-missing/non-host-provider → FAIL; off-catalogue model or missing `provider/` → WARN-and-pass-through. Same core is reused by `doctor` and emits soft warnings at `init`/`run`.
- **Backward compat:** old `derrick.yaml` files with `provider: anthropic`/`openai-cli`/`copilot-cli` or the removed `endpoint`/`region`/`base_url` fields still load — aliased/parse-and-ignored with a one-line warn (no config-version bump).

## One follow-up worth flagging

**aider is not installed on this machine**, so its argv (`--model … --message … --yes-always --no-auto-commits --no-stream --no-pretty --no-show-release-notes`) was implemented from the documented flag set, not validated against a real binary. copilot and opencode flags *were* verified against the installed CLIs. Before relying on the aider host in anger, confirm `--no-show-release-notes` exists in your pinned aider version and that a bad `--model` warns rather than hard-fails (which is what the warn-and-pass-through guarantee assumes).

Per the orchestration model, the natural next move is a Codex review pass over the diff before commit — say the word and I'll dispatch it, or commit as-is if you'd rather review yourself.

content.text:
Codex came back **DO-NOT-SHIP** with 5 findings. Let me evaluate them rather than apply blindly — a couple are clear bugs, one is a design judgement against an approved decision:

- **#1 `shell` provider (blocker):** Codex says `shell` violates the "5 hosts only" invariant since it can shell out to anything. But keeping `shell` as a generic escape hatch was an **explicit, approved** part of the plan and design-keeper's §6.5 rewrite — so it's intended scope, not a bug. Codex's *real* point is valid though: `models check` silently reporting it **PASS** hides it. Right resolution: keep `shell`, but make the check report it as **WARN** ("unmanaged escape hatch"), not PASS.

input.command:
git commit -F - <<'EOF'
feat(models): route all inference through 5 host CLIs, no BYOK (D64)

Collapse derrick's model layer onto the host-CLI boundary. Every model
role now resolves to one of five host CLIs — claude, codex, copilot,
opencode, aider — each of which manages its own auth. derrick holds no
API keys: the direct-API providers (anthropic, openai-cli API mode) and
the API-key/credential machinery are removed. Supersedes D12; rewrites
DESIGN.md §6.5.

- derrick-tools: new curated model catalogue (catalogue.rs) as the single
  source of truth for per-host default + known model ids and per-host
  --model normalisation (strip provider/ for claude/codex/copilot; keep
  provider/model for opencode/aider; never translate dot<->dash). New
  aider host adapter (headless: --message, --yes-always, --no-auto-commits,
  --no-dirty-commits, --no-stream, --no-pretty, --no-show-release-notes).
  All five adapters normalise --model. Redacting Debug for HostRequest so
  the forwarded process env cannot leak.
- derrick-models: providers collapse into one host-delegated provider that
  builds a HostRequest and calls the derrick-tools adapter, wrapping the
  HostResponse into a one-shot completion stream. Delete anthropic/
  openai_cli/opencode/subprocess providers; drop reqwest. AuthStore shrinks
  to env-passthrough only; ModelError::MissingCredential removed. Io errors
  classified by ErrorKind for retryability.
- derrick-config: Config::defaults() aligned to host providers with current
  ids (claude-opus-4-8, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5, codex/gpt-5.5,
  copilot/gpt-5.4). Host enum gains Opencode + Aider. ModelDef sheds API-only
  fields (endpoint/region/deployment/base_url, parse-and-ignore for old
  configs); one-release provider alias map (anthropic->claude,
  openai-cli->codex, copilot-cli->copilot) at finalize.
- derrick-cli: new `derrick models check` (host installed -> FAIL; off-catalogue
  model -> WARN; non-host provider -> FAIL; opencode/aider missing slash -> WARN;
  shell -> WARN as unmanaged escape hatch). Shared core reused by doctor and
  emitted as soft warnings at init/run. doctor's API-key checks removed.

Validated with a Codex read-only review pass; all findings addressed.
fmt + clippy + cargo test --workspace green (0 failures).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
